item.title: v0.4.0
item.description:
What's new

  • The Control Plane inside the app (macOS 14 and later). Usage and the Control Plane open in the app itself, each account signed in on its own. Reload, or open the page in your browser, from the toolbar. On other systems they open in your browser.
  • Usage and Control Plane, one click away. The Control Plane place opens your account's own Usage dashboard and Control Plane.
  • A cleaner, more readable app. Clearer text and colours with stronger contrast, a calmer MCP Servers page (Remove now sits in Edit…), tool counts in Permissions, and an easier request box.

Fixed

  • Each account keeps its own colour, and an account that has not connected yet no longer shows its API address.
  • The pane's sign-in is kept away from bots: no bot can be given the folders where the app stores it.
